ios.desc:
ROAMO: Honor & Memorialize Roadside Memorials

ROAMO (ROAdside meMOrial) is a heartfelt app designed to honor the lives of those lost in road-related tragedies. Discover, share, and memorialize roadside tributes through photos, videos, and heartfelt memories. Whether you’re preserving the memory of a loved one or discovering roadside memorials near you, ROAMO provides a space for connection and remembrance.

Key Features:

- Discover Memorials on a Map: Explore an interactive map that showcases roadside memorials across different regions. Easily find memorials near your location, or search for specific ones by location or name.

- Create & Share Memorials: Upload photos and videos, and share the story behind the memorial. Add personal details like the location of the incident, age, and gender of the deceased.

- Engage & Connect: Comment on memorials, reply to others, and react using emojis to show your support and condolences.

- Memorial Stories: Share and read touching stories about the lives behind the memorials. Connect with others who’ve experienced similar losses and offer your heartfelt messages.

- Community of Support: Join a growing community of people who believe in honoring and remembering the memories of those lost. Follow updates and engage with the latest memorials near you.

New in Version 2.0.0+:

- Primary stewards can now edit memorials
- Memorial mapping via panning or address search
- Guest User Experience: New flow allows guest users to explore memorials and seamlessly convert to registered accounts when ready to contribute
- Enhanced Stewardship Tools: Improved invitation system and primary steward transfer features make collaboration easier
- Interface Refinements: Cleaner memorial card layouts, resolved avatar display issues, and pull-to-refresh functionality for updated content
- Enhanced guest user experience
- Improved memorial stewardship tools for better collaboration
- Refined user interface with smoother navigation and clearer memorial cards
- Increased app stability and performance improvements
- Updated visual branding

Download ROAMO today to keep the memories of loved ones alive, honor their stories, and discover a deeper connection through remembrance.
